best_for: Owners of an older Elgato Facecam or Cam Link whose PC or Mac cannot run Elgato Studio, and who need to keep tuning the camera they already have.
description:
Camera Hub is Elgato's desktop app for its webcams, camera capture devices and the Elgato Prompter teleprompter. It is published by Corsair Memory, Inc.

Use it to fine-tune a camera's picture, starting with white balance. The Device dialog shows details that help with troubleshooting, such as a camera's hardware revision and USB transfer mode. With a Prompter connected, Camera Hub runs your scripts and its Voice Sync feature. If you later move to Elgato Studio, it can import those Prompter scripts, so you do not have to start over.

points.title: No longer updated
points.text: Elgato now calls Camera Hub legacy. It can still be downloaded, but it gets no more updates. Elgato Studio 2.0 replaces it and also takes over from 4K Capture Utility.

points.title: Why you might stay on it
points.text: Elgato Studio needs Windows 11, on 64-bit or Arm64, or macOS 15 Sequoia or later. On a Windows 10 PC or an older Mac, Camera Hub is the tool that still installs.

points.title: Check your camera against Studio
points.text: Studio supports Facecam MK.2, 4K, Pro and Neo, Cam Link 4K and Pro, the Prompter and a range of capture cards. If your device is on that list and your system qualifies, Studio is the one that will keep getting fixes.

points.title: The last release tuned the Facecam 4K
points.text: Camera Hub 2.3 came with Facecam 4K firmware 2.49, which improves noise, motion blur, color and HDR range, and adds a manual tint control for magenta and green.

points.title: Free with the hardware
points.text: The app costs nothing, but it only does something useful with an Elgato camera or capture device plugged in.

points.title: Versions on this page
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 22 versions of the x64 installer, which installs for all users. The Mac build is one universal installer for Intel and Apple silicon, and only the current release is listed.
